description: This file defines the ConditionService interface which specifies methods for managing Condition objects within the OpenMRS system, including retrieval, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and purging conditions.

classes.name: ConditionService
classes.description: Interface defining service methods for managing Condition entities in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition object by its UUID with authorization check.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Gets a list of active conditions for a specified patient with authorization.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Retrieves all conditions (active and inactive) associated with a patient, available since version 2.2.1.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided conditions associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieve a condition by its internal ID with authorization.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Saves or updates a condition object with authorization.

methods.name: voidCondition
methods.description: Voids a condition specifying a reason, with authorization.

methods.name: unvoidCondition
methods.description: Revives a previously voided condition, removing the void status, with authorization.

methods.name: purgeCondition
methods.description: Completely deletes a condition from the database, usually not recommended, with authorization.
